scope: Current published declarations only: 60 video models and 5 video app APIs, 139 modes per independent canvas catalogue. Retain meaningful sound/quality/speed controls; hide optional technical and material extras. No SKU, complete contract, HTTP E2E or provider certification is inferred.

policy.optional_extras: Hidden, use reliable declared defaults or omit; old persisted metadata retained; old optional group bindings are detached only in outgoing regular requests.
policy.required_materials: Keep required inputs and structured clip/frame inputs needed by selected uploads; never invent missing clip bounds, subjects or role IDs.
